project_type: React + Zustand SPA with Konva canvas, Vite build
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, vi mocking
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build
verification_instructions: Run vitest --run to ensure all 716+ tests pass. Run vite build to ensure no type/compile errors.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npm install (already done - node_modules present)
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running node/npx. react-konva mocked in tests as jsdom has no canvas.
contribution_requirements: All tests must pass. Use existing patterns. Zustand stores with create(). Hooks for interactions. Tests mock @/lib/supabase and react-konva.
key_patterns: Zustand stores (canvasStore, projectStore) with typed State+Actions interfaces. Canvas interactions as custom hooks in src/canvas/interactions/. Zone constraints in src/canvas/utils/zoneConstraints.ts. CanvasMode.DESIGNER vs CONSULTANT guards. Tests use vi.mock for supabase/konva. projectStore has FINALIZED guards on mutations. Toolbar.tsx renders mode-dependent buttons. Components use data-testid attributes.
directory_structure: frontend/src/canvas/ - CanvasContainer + interactions/ hooks + layers/ + utils/ + __tests__. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/components/ - UI panels/dialogs. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript types. frontend/src/lib/ - utilities (supabase, coordinates, autosave).
